games.name: Wilson's PRISON (SCARY OBBY)
games.desc:
You've just been put in the world's most secure prison meant for only the worst of the worst criminals... Unfortunately for you, the prison has hired Wilson to watch over the inmates. This won't be so easy... LET'S ESCAPE!

⚠️ GAME CONTAINS JUMPSCARES AND LOUD NOISES ⚠️

Finished easy mode? Try hard mode!

Can you escape Wilson and make it to stage 19 of this obby / parkour? He will be chasing you in his multiple forms!

If you had fun I'd be so appreciative if you were to leave a 👍 and favorite, ❤️.

If you're stuck on a stage make sure to check out some of the fun power-ups in the shop, any purchases are greatly appreciated and support me in making future games but don't feel pressured, simply playing the game is just as meaningful to me as a developer ❤️. Have fun!

Join the Decent Obbies group if you don't want to miss out on future obby games!

games.name: [🏁NEW] Track Race
games.desc:
Welcome to Track Race, the ultimate track and field running simulator on Roblox! Step onto the track, lace up your shoes, and feel the adrenaline rush as you compete against players from around the world in thrilling races!

🏃‍♂️RUN CONTROLS🏃‍♂️
- PC: Spam Q + E to Run
- Console: Spam R1 + L1 (right/left bumpers) to Run
- Mobile: Spam Right and Left Mobile buttons to Run

🚀 Sprint to Victory: Test your speed and endurance in various race types, getting progressively harder each world!
🏋️Train & Win More: Increase your power and stamina by training on the machines during intermission!
🥇Get to the Top & Win Medals: Get Top 3 and have a chance of rolling a random medal!
📦Customize: Buy crates and look cool on the field with custom Starter Blocks and Trails!
🏆Beat World Records: Evolve, Train and get quicker to beat Record Breaking Times in each world!
